summary.text: Janet Beaudoin is the Republican candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 94, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democratic incumbent Scott Harriman.
She lost to Harriman in a February 24, 2026 special election for the same seat.

paragraphs.text: Beaudoin first appeared on the ballot for District 94 in 2022, when she was the Republican nominee and lost to incumbent Democrat Kristen Cloutier, 1,211 votes (40.0 percent) to 1,813 (60.0 percent).
In the February 24, 2026 special general election for District 94, Scott Harriman defeated Beaudoin, 572 votes (53.2 percent) to 503 (46.8 percent).
